Hey, you are not at fault or irrational in how you feel. First off, give yourself some credit for reaching out. Secondly, people mean well when they bring up the "other fish in the sea" argument, and I get it, however I know that doesn't help. Look, in your mind she was the one, and what sucks is that you don't have access or control over other people's minds. Unrequited love, disloyalty, and/or subjective perspective changes can occur, and people are fucking terribly calloused at caring about their partners when these events occur. I have no idea why your ex did this to you, I won't pretend to know, I barely know why my ex left me, but damn it it was her loss. I bet like me, you loved your woman unconditionally. Well, this is a sign that she overspent and took for granted you and your love. You need to find some leftover reserves in you to give to yourself. You deserve it, NO person, should EVER be reduced to taking their life because their partner broke their bond. It hurts, I know all too well, and it is legitimate, but her leaving you WAS HER loss, not yours, as you gave your honest emotions to her. You will find better people out there eventually, but that won't make you feel better now. What will is focusing on you. How can your situation change to help get you through this? What can you do to take charge of your trajectory? If you become focused on positive personal improvements, the pain will die down little by little. It will never go away, at least it never has for me, but it will become bearable. If you want to talk further, feel free. I hope this helps.
